testcase.name: [Monitor:legacy-node-invariants][sig-node] pods should never transition back to pending
[Monitor:legacy-node-invariants][sig-node] should not encounter ErrImagePull read connection timeout in openshift namespace pods
[Monitor:legacy-node-invariants][sig-node] should not encounter ErrImagePull read connection timeout in non-openshift namespace pods
[Monitor:legacy-node-invariants][sig-node] should not encounter ErrImagePull QPS exceeded error in openshift namespace pods
[Monitor:legacy-node-invariants][sig-node] should not encounter ErrImagePull QPS exceeded error in non-openshift namespace pods
[Monitor:legacy-node-invariants][sig-node] should not encounter ErrImagePull manifest unknown error in openshift namespace pods
[Monitor:legacy-node-invariants][sig-node] should not encounter ErrImagePull manifest unknown error in non-openshift namespace pods
[Monitor:legacy-node-invariants][sig-node] should not encounter ErrImagePull in openshift namespace pods
[Monitor:legacy-node-invariants][sig-node] should not encounter ErrImagePull in non-openshift namespace pods
[Monitor:legacy-node-invariants][sig-node] kubelet should be able to delete cgroups path
[Monitor:legacy-node-invariants][sig-node] kubelet should not use an anonymous user
